item.tib: gshed dmar me ri 'bar ba'i rgyud las ma mo srid pa spyi 'dul dbal mo las kyi thig le'i mde'u thung thog ser zlog byed
item.coloph: ces 'jigs byed gshin rje gshed dmar gyi rgyud las dbal mo las kyi thig le'i mde'u thung thog ser zlog byed ye shes me dpung 'di ni/ rje mtshungs med gsang sngags grags pa khu dbon dang*/ bstan sbyin nor bu gnyis kyi bka' yis bskul ba dang*/ gnas skabs phas rgol log pa'i thog ser skyi 'dangs kyi las mtha' yi/ gdul bya'i zhing khams brlag nges byed kyi gtam rkyang byung tshe/ thos chung kun grol grags pa bdag gis shar phyogs rgyal mo rong gi nub phyogs/ bstan 'dzin bon gyi rgyal po'i zhing khams/ lhun grub dpag bsam ljon pa'i gling du mgyogs par bgyis pa me sbrul zla tshes la dge'o//
